title: Centuries of History
text: The Alcazar is an amazing place full of centuries of wonderful history. It would have been overwhelming without tour guide Valentin to share his extensive knowledge of history and culture and provide highlights for us. Afterwards we had as much time as we wanted to keep browsing around to explore the palace on our own time.
author: G4513DGjudyt

title: Excellent tour and day...
text: Excellent tour and day spent in Cordoba exploring its beautiful sites. Highly recommend when visiting Cordoba.
author: Laura_E

title: Good day. Nice guides
text: The guides were excellent and gave great recommendations on where to find lunch. We learned a lot and we enjoyed the day.
author: Elliot_H

title: Cordoba with Driss is a must!
text: Our tour guide was Driss and we had an amazing time. He was able to lead a tour in 3 different languages simultaneously without making it feel like we were dragging on or just waiting for our turn to hear what he had to share. Driss was informative, passionate about Cordoba, insightful, kind, and funny. We had plenty of time to explore each area we visited, and got a good sense of the town and history. Even with the heat, we had a great time and would definitely recommend.
author: hangrala

title: Great excursion!
text: Maria was a great tour guide! Very knowledgeable and helpful! This excursion was exactly what I was looking for.
author: Amanda_R

title: A must see!
text: The tour was amazing! The guide was very knowledgeable and explained the history of the city in multiple languages.  The Mosque Cathedral was beautiful and definitely made the trip worth it. We took two children with us and the amount of walking was a bit much for them but we have plenty of time to sit while listening to the guide.
author: Ritesh_S

title: Wonderful
text: It was really well ran. Martina did a wonderful job and stuck to the timings. Very informative and even gave us a tour around the town.
author: Zayneb_E

title: Great Day!
text: Immersive, informative day trip. Our guide, Carmella, was knowledgeable, helpful, and quick thinking when unexpected moments arose. She created a perfect day for us.
author: Robert_K

title: Well done Jesus
text: Very good experience, our guide Jesus was brilliant. Very helpful with locating our friends in Cordoba
author: Alan_R

title: Great day!
text: Extremely personable. Extremely knowledgeable and very friendly group. We thoroughly enjoyed our tour with Jesus. The mosque/cathedral was incredible! Worth the trip for sure!
author: deborah_c
